verdict.rationale: pnpm has explicit CI-specific documentation: it auto-detects CI environments and switches to frozen-lockfile mode, fails installs if the lockfile is out of date, works with no Node.js pre-installed (self-contained executable that can install runtime itself), and supports config like packageManager pinning for reproducible CI runs. Community evidence corroborates fast, reliable CI performance. Missing for 10: no first-party CI provider integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions marketplace action specifics) or explicit headless/non-interactive automation examples beyond CI lockfile behavior.
